applicant.name: Dr. Katharina Moser
applicant.organisation: Austrian Trauma Registry, orthogeriatrics working group

purpose: We compare orthogeriatric care pathways between hospitals to find out where hip fracture patients stay longest and why, so that discharge planning can be improved.
question: For hip fracture admissions, how many stays did each hospital have from 2023 to 2025 and how long did they last on average?
definitions: Hip fracture admission = an inpatient encounter whose primary_icd10 begins with S72.
Length of stay = end_date minus start_date, in days.
Count admissions, not people. All years in the data (2023-2025) count.
Report per hospital (data_holder): hip fracture admissions and their mean length of stay in days, one decimal.
